evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned through Gotenks training. The user exhales five ghosts which launch sequentially after about five seconds; current dedicated documentation reports the first and last ghosts at 10% damage and intermediate ghosts at up to 20%. The record is the Ultimate variant, distinct from the 100-Ki Super variant.
